prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a production transparent sprite atlas for a hand-painted historical maritime RPG. Exactly 24 separate full body poses in strict 6 columns x 4 rows, landscape canvas 2304x1536, each cell 384x384, clear gutters. Each pose wholly within its cell, entire head, hands, feet, and sword tip visible. Consistent same adult person, costume, proportions, camera and scale, facing RIGHT with side-three-quarter view. No grid, labels, captions, floor, shadows, backgrounds or lettering. Truly transparent alpha background. Detailed realistic painterly game art, no chibi. Adult handsome East-Asian-looking male captain, swept black hair, long fitted black coat with silver embroidery and chains, white open-collar shirt, black gloves and boots. Preserve reference face and outfit. Wield one ornate silver-hilt rapier. All 24 poses form four rows: row 1 parry sequence (neutral ready, high guard, blade parry, bracing, relax, neutral); row 2 defensive sequence (guard, low guard, middle guard, stepping back, regain balance, neutral); row 3 hit sequence (flinch, recoil, clutch side, stumble backward, recover, neutral); row 4 EXACTLY: neutral standing sword low; command with raised free hand; kneeling on one knee; collapsing low; lying flat on back side view horizontal full body; rising to kneel. Last-but-one figure MUST be truly prone and horizontal, height less than one third its width. No blood or injuries. ANATOMY REQUIREMENT: show an unmistakable natural FIVE-digit sword grip. Four fingers fully curled around the cylindrical leather handle, thumb visibly opposing and crossing the index finger, handle enclosed INSIDE palm, continuous wrist-to-forearm connection. Blade guard in front of knuckles, pommel at little-finger side. Angle the wrist slightly to show the thumb as well as curled fingers, no fist merely resting above handle. No extra fingers, no straight dangling fingertips. All held objects must touch and be occluded by fingers.
